Portable 5.12 kWh LiFePO4 power station for home backup and off-grid use. 5000 W continuous output, 10-year warranty, EU Battery Regulation compliant.

Specifications
- Capacity: 5.12 kWh
- Chemistry: Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4)
- Nominal voltage: 51.2 V
- Continuous output: 5000 W
- Expected lifetime: 4000 cycles
- Weight: 48.2 kg
- Warranty: 10 years

Compliance
EU Battery Regulation compliant.
